method: corridor centre = midpoint of the two block faces read off the plate's own street chain; identity from the current placement (the two readings are within 150 ft, a block is 398 ft); a cross-axis tie: the corridor both plates draw across their shared band
why_rejected: The two plates share no street: 66 covers 30th-33rd and 74 covers 33rd-36th (key map, and 74's own outlot quarters S.E. 136 / N.E. 161 sit directly above 81/82's N.W. 136 / N.W.-S.W. 161 and beside 99's S.E. 161). The tie matched 66's 31st St to 74's 34th St because the placement it was read under already had 74 one row north; it then held it there.
